newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia shares volume slips, Daugavpils gains.
newsitem.headline: Latvia shares volume slips, Daugavpils gains.

text.p: Latvian stock volumes slipped on Tuesday amid slow trade although Daugavpils Chain factory again advanced ahead of a shareholders' meeting, dealers said.
Turnover came to 116,000 lats against 129,000 lats and the Rietumu index closed down 1.69 percent at 195.49.
"This was a calm day, in line with April's trend towards stagnation," Parex Bank dealer Leonid Ruderman said.
"I would also link it to current T-bill rates and the remarks of the finance minister about possible rises (in T-bill rates)," he added.
If people are expecting T-bills rates to rise, they will be less eager to trade shares, he added.
Daugavpils Chain was the most traded stock on volume of 42,800 lats as it added five santimes to 2.65 lats.
"Daugavpils is fluctuating and will come to its actual price after the shareholders' meeting," Ruderman said. The company's shareholders meeting is on April 18.
Official list's Unibanka and Riga Transport Fleet were also in demand on volume of 21,600 and 19,500 lats respectively. Unibanka was stable at 3.80 lats and RTF slipped to 1.58 lats from 1.61 lats.
Valmiera and Lode Brick, both active secondary list shares, maintained recent fluctuations and slipped.
Valmiera saw 7,400 lats of shares traded as it closed down at 1.62 lats from 1.79 lats while Lode dropped to 2.48 from 2.60 lats on a small volume of 300 lats.

"It (Valmiera) could be explained by one rather big shareholder being in need of funds... its price may go up from this level," Dmitri Krutik, Rietumu Bank trader, said in his daily statement on the market's activity.
Elsewhere on the official list, Staburadze advanced five santimes to 2.66 lats on volume of 6,700 lats.
Roja fish cannery registered business worth 4,500 lats as it lost one santime to 2.82 lats.
Kaija, ready to join the official list soon after April 20, maintained its rise, adding another two santimes to 2.56 lats. It had volume of 2,000 lats.
Rigas Alus remained stable at 1.70 lats and traded 2,000 lats while finished two santimes down at 0.60 santimes on volume of 1,600 lats.
